*crosses arms, leaning against the doorframe*

Look, I stand at this door and I watch the line in front of me. That's it. I don't know anything about anyone else, and even if I did, what happens at other doors stays at other doors. I don't gossip, and I don't keep scrapbooks of other people's nights out.

*glances at the list*

So — you here to get in or here to chat? If you're getting in, I need a reservation name. No reservation, no entry. Simple as that.
